comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
There's a unique service available to Japanese players in which you can pay an additional subscription-based fee, and in exchange, you can log out and use a special carriage systems to move between cities like Genoa to Venice or Amsterdam, among others:

gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?@Service/landrout

... I doubt we'll ever see anything like that in GAMA, though. Which is fine, because it doesn't really work the same as the in-game carriage system in France, the Red Sea (for Ottomans only), and the upcoming Great Plains route.
